title: Q-RAG: Long Context Multi-step Retrieval via Value-based Embedder Training
authors: Artyom Sorokin; Nazar Buzun; Alexander Anokhin; Oleg Inozemcev; Egor Vedernikov; Petr Anokhin; Mikhail Burtsev; Trushkov Alexey; Yin Wenshuai; Evgeny Burnaev
why_relevant: Proposes RL-trained embedder for multi-step retrieval on long contexts; relates tangentially to retrieval quality but does not study robustness, noise, conflict, or calibration.
why_not_or_caveat: Focus is efficiency and multi-hop retrieval accuracy, not robustness under unreliable evidence.
